# SectionCard

A Card whose label sits inside it: a SectionHeader, an optional quote, then the content.

`NomNom.SectionCard` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.SectionCard>…</NomNom.SectionCard>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.SectionCard">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

A Card whose label sits inside it. One shape — Card + Eyebrow + optional quote. A label *above* a card is `<Section title=…><Card>…</Card></Section>`, not this.

## Props (SectionCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | The Eyebrow inside the card. |
| `trailing` | `unknown` | One figure beside the label — a count, a date. |
| `trailingVariant` | `'secondary' \| 'primary'` |  |
| `uppercase` | `boolean` | false for a possessive label ("Joel's note"). @default true |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `variant` | `'primary'` | 'primary' tints the card and turns the label primary-text semibold. |
| `quote` | `string` | The cook's note: italic serif-xs, no quotation marks. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
| `children` | `unknown` |  |
